label: M-02
resolution: False-positive. Donation to sUSDe is genuine non-recoverable yield (value-positive, self-defeating as attack). Deposit-DoS direction is backwards (higher share price lowers minOut). Withdraw-DoS requires AMM/vault price to decouple and stay decoupled — closed by arbitrage / prevented by NG rate oracle. PoC only passed via a mock AMM hard-coded to ignore vault price.
title: vault.convertToAssets / convertToShares used as price oracle across deposits, withdrawals, and surplus calculations — ERC4626 internal rate is manipulable by donating underlying to the vault, enabling DoS or over-extraction of surplus
description: All four economically sensitive computations trust vault.convertToAssets/convertToShares as an accurate price oracle. For vaults whose exchange rate is determined by totalAssets/totalSupply, a same-block donation of underlying inflates convertToAssets. This also inflates the surplus ceiling check (require totalShares <= convertToShares(aggregateSurplus)).
impact: Primary realistic risk: DoS of deposit, withdrawal, and skimSurplus operations during a manipulated price spike (minOut becomes unsatisfiable, swap reverts). Secondary risk for skimSurplus: extraction of more underlying than the real yield warrants if the Curve pool tracks the vault's inflated rate. ECON-004 adds: the deposit solvency invariant is share-terms not underlying-terms, leaving a gap at AMM discount.
attackPath: Attacker donates underlying tokens directly to the ERC4626 vault, inflating totalAssets
vault.convertToAssets(shares) returns inflated values in the same block
In _depositInternal: minOut (derived from inflated convertToShares) becomes unsatisfiable against the real AMM rate; swap reverts, DoS-ing deposits
In _withdrawInternal: same inflation causes minOut > actual swap output; withdrawals revert
In _skimSurplus: inflated surplus ceiling check (require totalShares <= convertToShares(aggregateSurplus)) passes when it should not, potentially allowing surplus extraction exceeding real yield
Attack cost: the donated tokens are not recoverable (classic ERC4626 inflation vector)
